posts.text:
🎓 Learning never stops, and every workshop is an opportunity to grow.
I'm excited to share that I successfully completed a 5-Day Offline Workshop on Computer Vision with Python, organized by Innomatics Research Labs from 13th–17th July 2026. During the workshop, I was recognized with a Certificate of Excellence for my performance and dedication.
Throughout the workshop, I had the opportunity to strengthen my understanding of:
✨ Image Processing Fundamentals
 ✨ Computer Vision using Python
 ✨ OpenCV Libraries and Applications
 ✨ Object Detection & Image Analysis Concepts
 ✨ Hands-on Problem Solving and Practical Implementation
Beyond the technical concepts, this experience reinforced the importance of curiosity, continuous learning, and applying theoretical knowledge to real-world challenges.
A heartfelt thank you to Innomatics Research Labs for conducting such an engaging and insightful workshop, and to Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering for providing opportunities that encourage practical learning and skill development.
Looking forward to applying these concepts in future AI and Computer Vision projects while continuing to expand my knowledge in emerging technologies.
Innomatics Research Labs
Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, BANGALORE
@Supriya Seetharam
#ComputerVision #Python #OpenCV #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #Innomatics #Learning #Workshop #ContinuousLearning #Technology #SoftwareDevelopment #DSCE #MCA #CareerGrowth

🎉 Excited to Share Another Milestone! 🎉
While I completed this certification a few months ago, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on how much it has contributed to my learning journey.

I'm delighted to share that I have successfully completed the Generative AI + Prompt Engineering + ChatGPT programme offered by EXCELR.
Throughout this learning journey, I gained practical knowledge in:
✨ Generative AI Fundamentals
 ✨ Prompt Engineering Techniques
 ✨ ChatGPT for Real-World Applications
 ✨ AI-Powered Content Generation
 ✨ Problem Solving with Large Language Models (LLMs)
 ✨ Best Practices for AI-Driven Workflows
This course has strengthened my understanding of modern AI technologies and equipped me with practical skills to build intelligent, AI-powered solutions. It has also enhanced my ability to think creatively, solve problems efficiently, and leverage AI responsibly.
A heartfelt thank you to EXCELR and the instructors for designing such an insightful and hands-on learning experience.
I'm excited to continue exploring the ever-evolving world of Artificial Intelligence and apply these skills to real-world projects.
Looking forward to many more learning opportunities ahead! 🚀
ExcelR
#GenerativeAI #PromptEngineering #ChatGPT #ArtificialIntelligence #LLM #AI #MachineLearning #ContinuousLearning #Upskilling #CareerGrowth #EXCELR #OpenToWork

🎉 Excited to Share My Internship Completion! 🎉
I am thrilled to share that I have successfully completed my Backend Developer Internship (Python, Flask, SQL) at Shramic Networks Private Limited.
During this internship, I had the opportunity to work on real-world backend development projects, where I enhanced my knowledge and practical skills in:
✨ Python Programming
✨ Flask Web Framework
✨ SQL & Database Management
✨ REST API Development
✨ Backend System Design & Problem Solving
✨ Debugging, Testing & Code Optimization
This internship provided me with valuable industry exposure and strengthened my understanding of backend application development. Beyond technical skills, I also improved my analytical thinking, collaboration, adaptability, and professional communication by working in a team-oriented environment.
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to my mentors and the entire team at Shramic Networks Private Limited for their constant guidance, encouragement, and support throughout this journey. Their mentorship played a significant role in my learning and professional growth.
A heartfelt thanks to Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering and Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) for providing this opportunity to bridge academic knowledge with practical industry experience.
This internship has inspired me to continue expanding my skills in software development and backend technologies. I look forward to taking on new challenges, contributing to innovative projects, and growing as a software engineer.
Thank you to everyone who has supported and encouraged me throughout this journey! 🙌
Shramic Networks
Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, BANGALORE

#Internship #BackendDevelopment #Python #Flask #SQL #RESTAPI #SoftwareDevelopment #Learning #CareerGrowth #MCA #VTU #DSCE #ShramicNetworks #OpenToWork #FutureReady 🚀

Excited to share that I have started my journey as a Backend Developer Intern (Python, Flask, SQL) at Shramic Networks Private Limited from 16 February 2026.
I am grateful for the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in backend development and work with real-world technologies while learning from experienced professionals. Looking forward to building, learning, and contributing during this internship journey.
A sincere thanks to everyone at Shramic Networks for this opportunity and to all the mentors and team members who support interns in growing professionally.
#Internship #BackendDevelopment #Python #Flask #SQL #LearningJourney#Shramic Networks Private Limited

Excited to share that I’ve successfully completed a 12-week NPTEL course on “Artificial Intelligence: Concepts and Techniques” with Elite Badge
 This experience has been incredibly enriching, adding valuable knowledge and technical depth to my professional journey.
A huge thank you to NPTEL, IISc , and the SWAYAM platform for offering high-quality, industry-relevant courses that make advanced learning accessible to everyone. The course was challenging, insightful, and truly rewarding.
Throughout the 12 weeks, I gained a strong foundation in:
 🔹 Problem-solving and intelligent agent design
 🔹 Uninformed & heuristic search techniques
 🔹 Constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs)
 🔹 Knowledge representation and logical reasoning
 🔹 Probabilistic models & Bayesian networks
 🔹 Fundamentals of machine learning
 🔹 AI planning and decision-making techniques
This certification reflects my commitment to continuous learning and staying updated in a rapidly evolving tech landscape. Feeling proud, motivated, and excited to apply these AI concepts to real-world projects! 🚀🤖
NPTEL | IISc Bangalore | SWAYAM
#NPTEL #ArtificialIntelligence #OnlineLearning #AI #MachineLearning #ProfessionalDevelopment #ContinuousLearning #Certification #TechSkills #SkillsForSuccess #AICourse
